violation_type.title: Substitutes and Volunteers - Complete Orientation Before Beginning Relevant Duties (26 TAC §746.1401(g))
violation_type.short_title: Substitutes and Volunteers - Complete Orientation Before Beginning Relevant Duties
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed in relation to the DFPS investigation and found to be deficient. One substitute present at the operation did not have a complete orientation before being counted in child/caregiver ratio.

finding_variants.text: This standard was reviewed in relation to the DFPS investigation and found to be deficient. One substitute present at the operation did not have a complete orientation before being counted in child/caregiver ratio.
A volunteers file was observed and has not completed orientation.
